Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (August 15, 2024) from the Chief Procurement Officer: Solicitation Number: Request for Quotation Doc4505719273 Description: For the supply and delivery of Eight (8) Latest Model Conventional Cab And Chassis, Diesel Engine, with Various Body Configurations, with option to purchase an additional Nineteen (19) Units in 2024-2025 and Twenty Two (22) Units in 2025-2026, pending budget availability. Upon Award of this Request for Quotation, the Supplier and the City will have a Contract from the date of award to August 31, 2026 for a fixed term of two (2) years, all in accordance with the terms, conditions, and specifications contained in this Request for Quotation and any applicable City policy.
